say:2:1331029001:1.text: Of course. I grew up with Ganon in this town, you know?
say:2:1331029001:1.source_cn: 当然，我和加诺夫是在镇子里一起长大的，怎么可能不认识。
say:2:1331029001:1.male: Of course. I grew up with Ganon in this town, you know?
say:2:1331029001:1.female: Of course. I grew up with Ganon in this town, you know?

say:3:1331029002:1.text: Pelan, seriously, I don't know who you're talking about.
say:3:1331029002:1.source_cn: 可是皮陆斯，我根本不认识你说的那个人……

say:4:1331029003:1.text: Did I really get the wrong guy... Wait, you just called me by my name!
say:4:1331029003:1.source_cn: 难道我真的认错了……不对，我刚才听见你叫我的名字了！
